He uses the same model as a {{tc|Backpacker}}, albeit without the backpack. ==In the games== [[File:MC Sledge SV.png|250px|left|thumb|MC Sledge in {{g|Scarlet and Violet}}]] In {{g|Scarlet and Violet}}, MC Sledge is the one who welcomes the {{player}} and explains how the Gym Test works at the [[Montenevera Gym]]. After the second Gym {{pkmn|battle}}, he is the one who steps in and challenges the player to a [[Double Battle]]. He had a {{pkmn|battle}} with Roy to warm up the crowd for [[Ryme]]'s performance, after which he [[Battle judge|refereed]] the [[Tera Training]] match between Roy and Ryme. He served the same role in [[HZ062|the next episode]] by refereeing the two's [[rematch]]. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=MC Sledge |pkmn=Sableye |type1=Dark |type2=Ghost |img=MC Sledge Sableye.png |epnum=HZ061 |epname=Resonating Spirits in a Challenge to Ryme! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Sableye}} is MC Sledge's only known Pokémon.
